notes.title: Update 1.2.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]We’ve rolled out a new update to improve your gameplay experience, addressing the following issues:[/p][olist][*][p]Fixed incorrect text in Nicole’s second HCG scene.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a rare freeze that could occur before store checkout.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected occasional display glitches in Story and CG modes.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Thank you for playing and for all your valuable feedback. We'll keep working to make the game even better![/p]
